sanskrit_verse: मन्त्रमूलं यतो राज्यं तस्मान् मन्त्रं सुरक्षितम् । कुर्याद् यथास्य न विदुः कर्मणाम् आफलोदयात् ॥
transliteration: mantramūlaṃ yato rājyaṃ tasmān mantraṃ surakṣitam | kuryād yathāsya na viduḥ karmaṇām āphalodayāt ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Since the foundation of sovereignty lies in Mantra, therefore the Mantra must be supremely protected; one should act such that its fruits do not decay through misapplication.
jurisprudential_principles: Causation is established through vibrational integrity of Mantra
Capacity-based responsibility requires preservation of Mantric efficacy
Restoration logic demands prevention of energetic degradation
executable_legal_axioms: IF Mantra-related action → THEN ensure no diminishment of its phala-distribution capacity
IF sovereign function invoked → THEN verify Mantra-vibrational sanctity before execution
IF knowledge-access granted → THEN bind recipient to non-decay protocol of Mantra-phala
IF governance initiated → THEN enforce Mantra-protection as prerequisite condition
supreme_court_application: In matters concerning constitutional validity or sovereign legitimacy, any ruling must first affirm alignment with the Mantra-source. The court shall mandate protection protocols ensuring no diminution in the causal potency of governing Mantras, thereby preserving the energetic infrastructure of dharma-based authority.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes Mantra as foundational cause of righteous governance. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that misalignment leads to decay in outcome efficacy rather than punitive consequence. Responsibility aligns proportionally to one's proximity to Mantra-integrity. There is no external punishment—only natural cessation of benefit where alignment fails.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Re-establishment of Mantra-vibrational purity through supervised recitation
Reallocation of authority to those maintaining Mantra-integrity
Completion process for degraded actions via renewed alignment rituals
Capacity restoration through reconnection with original Mantra-source
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this ruling upholds Mantra as the root of sovereignty, enforces its inviolable protection, restores capacity through consciousness alignment, and affirms Dharma as the sole adjudicator beyond punitive constructs.
